marketplace.title: Egg Marketplace
marketplace.help: Add an Egg definition to the panel, then make it available to services. An added definition does not mean a service has been installed or started.
marketplace.importedHelp: Added versions are listed in the library. Their availability is controlled by enable/disable.
marketplace.publishIncomplete: Some imported definitions could not be identified. Check their status in the library.
marketplace.nextStep: Egg added. Enable it to make it available for services.

catalogFlow.steps: 1. Add definition → 2. Approve → 3. Make available to services
catalogFlow.nextStep: Definition added. Approve it and enable availability for services next.
catalogFlow.unsupported: Listed in the v2 catalog. Installation requires completing support for this Egg in the panel and agent; adding it is currently unavailable.
catalogFlow.EGG_V2_CATALOG_UNAVAILABLE: The v2 catalog could not be loaded. Other Eggs remain available.
catalogFlow.serviceUpdatesHelp: Apply this version to compatible service drafts using an older official Egg. Services with a started installation or active operation keep their assignment and appear in the results. Containers are neither restarted nor reinstalled.
catalogFlow.INSTALLATION_REQUIRES_REVIEW: Installation has already started; updating requires a separate review.
catalogFlow.SERVICE_OPERATION_ACTIVE: The service has an active operation or data from a started installation.
catalogFlow.CONFIGURATION_REQUIRES_REVIEW: The profile, environment or category requires adjustment for the new version.

activation.title: Egg availability
activation.introduction: Enable this Egg to make it available for service assignment.
activation.libraryHelp: Enabled Eggs can be assigned to new services. Disabling prevents new assignments and leaves existing services running. Updating the library and updating services are separate operations.
activation.approvalHelp: Approval confirms review of the definition. It does not enable the Egg automatically.
activation.approvalPermission: Approval requires egg:approve. Ask an administrator to review this version.
activation.availabilityHelp: Enable this Egg for new assignments. Disabling it does not stop or remove existing services.
activation.assignmentHelp: Open a service and its configuration. Choose a compatible category, this Egg and its application profile, then save the changes.
activation.servicesPermission: The service list requires service:read:any. A person managing the service can assign the Egg.
activation.completeSteps: Enable the Egg and its repository to make it available to services.
activation.repositoryHelp: This Egg's repository is disabled or archived. Check repositories — new assignments require an Egg from an active source.
activation.repositoryUnknown: Repository status could not be confirmed. Refresh the page before enabling the Egg.
activation.installationNote: Availability allows assignment. Installation readiness is checked separately for each service, including Agent support, resources and application variables.
activation.newVersionHelp: A new version retains the enabled state. Existing installations are not overwritten.

confirmHelp.approve: This approves the definition. Then choose “Enable for services” to make it available for assignment.
confirmHelp.reject: Rejection disables this Egg version. Existing installation definitions will not be overwritten.
confirmHelp.enable: The Egg will be available for new assignments. This does not start installation or change existing services.
confirmHelp.disable: This version will be unavailable for new assignments and installations. Existing assignments are preserved.

activation.enableHelp: Enable this Egg for new services.

eggs.automaticUpdatesNote: The panel checks the official repository hourly. Updates retain the previous enabled state. Automatically discovered new Egg families remain disabled. Updating definitions does not reinstall services.
eggs.enableAutomaticUpdates: Automatically check and import new Egg versions
eggs.updateSettingsPermissions: Changing this setting requires settings:manage, egg-repository:sync and egg:import.
eggs.catalogChecked: Available versions checked. Manual checks do not import Eggs.
eggs.syncFailed: The catalog check encountered a problem. Existing definitions were preserved.
eggs.noOfficialRepository: No active official Tyravex Eggs source is configured.
eggs.tagsNote: System tags are inferred from Egg definitions. Create your own tags with a chosen color. Personal tags are visible only to you; administrators can create shared tags.
eggs.confirmRemoveTag: Delete the tag “{{name}}” and its assignments? Egg definitions will be preserved.
eggs.confirmArchive: Remove this source from the active list? Definitions and service assignments will be preserved. The source will be unavailable for new installations.
eggs.invalidManifest: The manifest is unavailable, invalid, or uses an unsupported format.
eggs.contractV2Required: This Egg uses installation contract v2. Check requirements and actual blockers on the installation page of a specific service.
eggs.repositoryFormat: Use a GitHub repository URL or a direct HTTPS JSON index. GitHub sources are pinned to a commit. Tyravex repository schemaVersion 1 and native panel indexes are supported. URLs are immutable; add another repository to change the source.
eggs.name: Name
eggs.formatNote: Import a manifest, review its preview and choose whether to enable the Egg. Compatibility validation remains mandatory.
eggs.immutableNote: Existing versions are immutable. A new version retains the previous enabled state. Updating the library does not reinstall services.
eggs.approvalNote: Approval and availability are separate. Rejecting an Egg disables it. Existing installation definitions are not rewritten.
eggs.enableRepositoryFirst: Enable this repository before loading its catalog.
eggs.syncNote: Add an Egg to the library and choose its availability. Updates retain the previous enabled state; existing services are not reinstalled.
eggs.enableOnImport: Enable after adding (updates retain the previous state)
eggs.deleteUsed: An Egg version assigned to services cannot be deleted.
eggs.deleteHelp: Delete {{name}} version {{version}} from the library? Repository files will remain unchanged.
eggs.operationFailed: Operation failed. Refresh the list and try again.
